title: Cabbage Salad
description: Cabbage Salad is a fresh and colorful Chinese-inspired salad combining finely shredded green and purple cabbage, crisp carrots, bell peppers, and spring onions with a savory, tangy, lightly spicy sesame dressing. Toasted sesame seeds and roasted nuts add an elegant crunch, making it a refreshing restaurant-style side dish.

ingredients.title: For the Salad
items: Green cabbage – ½ small head, finely shredded
Purple cabbage – ½ small head, finely shredded
Carrots – 2 medium, julienned
Green onions – 4, thinly sliced diagonally
Red bell pepper – ½, thinly sliced
Fresh cilantro leaves – ¼ cup (optional)
Toasted sesame seeds – 2 tbsp
Crushed roasted peanuts or cashews – 2 tbsp (optional)

ingredients.title: For the Dressing
items: Soy sauce – 3 tbsp
Rice vinegar – 1 tbsp
Sesame oil – 1 tbsp
Sugar – 1 tsp (or honey for subtle sweetness)
Fresh ginger – 1 tsp, grated
Garlic – 1 small clove, finely minced
Chili oil – 1 tsp, or red chili flakes to taste
Neutral oil – 1–2 tbsp, such as vegetable or canola oil
Fish sauce – 1 tsp (optional, for extra umami)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Preparing the Vegetables
steps: Remove any tough outer leaves from the cabbages.
Finely shred the green and purple cabbage into uniform strips.
Julienne the carrots and thinly slice the red bell pepper and green onions.
Combine all prepared vegetables in a large mixing bowl.
Add cilantro if using and toss gently to distribute the ingredients.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Preparing the Dressing
steps: In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, sugar, ginger, garlic, chili oil, and fish sauce if using.
Taste the dressing and adjust the sweet, salty, tangy, and spicy elements.
Slowly drizzle in the neutral oil while whisking continuously to create a light emulsion.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Combining the Salad
steps: Pour the dressing evenly over the prepared vegetables.
Toss thoroughly but gently until every vegetable is lightly coated.
Allow the salad to rest for 5–10 minutes so the flavors can meld while the cabbage remains crisp.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Garnishing & Serving
steps: Transfer the salad to a shallow serving bowl or plate.
Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds over the top.
Add crushed roasted peanuts or cashews immediately before serving for maximum crunch.
Garnish with fresh cilantro leaves if desired.
Serve immediately for maximum freshness, or chill for 15–20 minutes for a more developed flavor.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve chilled or slightly cool as a refreshing Chinese-inspired side dish.
Pair with fried rice, stir-fried noodles, dumplings, or hot and sour soup.
Serve alongside grilled or stir-fried chicken, beef, shrimp, or tofu.
Add the nuts just before serving so they retain their crisp texture.

chefTips: Use a sharp knife or mandoline to achieve fine, uniform cabbage and carrot slices for better texture and presentation.
Taste the dressing before combining it with the vegetables; it should have a balanced salty, sweet, tangy, and spicy profile.
Do not overdress the salad, as excess liquid can make the cabbage watery.
Letting the dressed salad rest briefly softens the cabbage slightly while preserving its natural crunch.
Add toasted sesame seeds and nuts at the last moment to maintain their aroma and crispness.
Use a shallow bowl and arrange the purple cabbage, carrots, and bell peppers visibly for a professional restaurant presentation.
For a vegetarian version, omit the optional fish sauce.
